summaries.text: Motor Carrier Fairness Act of 2000 - Prohibits the Secretary of Transportation and the Administrator of the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration from taking any action to finalize, implement, or enforce the proposed rule entitled "Hours of Service of Drivers" published by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration in the Federal Register on May 2, 2000.
